motion.name: fringe-drift
motion.purpose: Spectral hairline travels while thinking or speaking.

components.name: Fringe button
components.css: .ds-btn-fringe { appearance: none; background: #fff; border: 1px solid transparent; background-image: linear-gradient(#fff,#fff), linear-gradient(90deg,#9fe8d4,#ffb7d4,#b9a8ff,#9fe8d4); background-origin: padding-box, border-box; background-clip: padding-box, border-box; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.28rem 0.85rem; font: 500 0.8rem 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; color: #3a424c; } .ds-btn-fringe:hover { background-image: linear-gradient(#f2f4f7,#f2f4f7), linear-gradient(90deg,#9fe8d4,#ffb7d4,#b9a8ff,#9fe8d4); } .ds-btn-fringe:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #b9a8ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.28rem; font: 500 0.8rem 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; color: #5a6470; } .ds-field input { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #5a6470 22%, white); border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; padding: 0.45rem 0.65rem; color: #3a424c; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #b9a8ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.northStar: The cloud body and its iridescent edge
narrative.overview: Leo’s window is a high-key cloud: white field, slate ink, a photograph of a newly formed cloud edge dissolving downward. Color is not a fill. The chat is the cloud body; configuration is the edge.
keyCharacteristics: One type family, thin for speech, medium for chrome
Spectral hairline instead of filled accents
Photograph as atmosphere, not illustration chrome
Operate density in the catalog sheet; emptiness in the chat

rules.name: The One Size Chrome Rule
rules.body: Catalog headings, buttons, and field labels share 0.8rem.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: The only edge is the iridescent hairline.

dos: Do keep the sky photograph as the first-viewport atmosphere.
Do put color only on hairlines and the active violet mark.
Do set messages as ink on white, labeled tú / Leo.
donts: Don't use chat bubbles, a thread sidebar, or a settings-app split.
Don't fill buttons or panels with mint, rose, or violet.
Don't introduce a second type family or a display serif.
